heading.en: Origins and early service

body.zh-Hant: 1846年5月20日生於威斯特法倫的明斯特。1865年進入威斯特法倫第6步兵團（編號55），並參加了1866年（南德）與1870至71年的戰事。
body.en: Born on 20 May 1846 at Münster (Westphalia). In 1865 he joined the 6th Westphalian Infantry Regiment (No. 55) and took part in the campaigns of 1866 (in southern Germany) and 1870/71.

citations.quote: * 20.5.1846 Münster (Westfalen)

an den Feldzügen von 1866 (in Süddeutschland) und 1870/71 teilnahm

heading.zh-Hant: 平時軍旅至軍團監察官
heading.en: Peacetime commands up to army inspector

body.zh-Hant: 1881至84年在於利希的軍士學校任職；1896至98年任柏林第一國民軍區指揮官；1906年任駐波森的第5軍軍長；1907年接替戈爾茨，任駐柯尼斯堡的第1軍軍長，至1913年；1913年晉升大將，接掌柏林的第8軍團監察部。
body.en: He served at the NCO school in Jülich (1881–84), commanded the Landwehr district Berlin I (1896–98), became commanding general of the V Army Corps at Posen (1906), succeeded Colmar von der Goltz at the I Army Corps in Königsberg in 1907 and led it until 1913; in 1913 he was promoted Generaloberst and took over the VIII Army Inspection in Berlin.

Kommandeur des Landwehrbezirks Berlin I (1896–98)

heading.en: First Army and the Battle of the Marne

body.zh-Hant: 1914年大戰爆發時，他以第1軍團總司令的身分，位於進攻法國的西線德軍右翼。8月，其各軍完成最長的行軍，並在莫伯日擊退英軍，9月初轉向南進。馬恩河會戰中，他的軍團擊退法軍所有反攻，但9月9日仍須服從由亨奇中校代表大本營傳達的撤至埃納河的命令。
body.en: When war broke out in 1914 he commanded the First Army on the right wing of the western army invading France. In August his corps made the longest marches and drove back the British at Maubeuge, then swung south in early September. In the Battle of the Marne his army mastered all French counter-attacks, yet on 9 September he had to obey the order, conveyed by Lt-Col Hentsch in the name of the Supreme Headquarters, to retire to the Aisne.

heading.zh-Hant: 義大利《意大利百科全書》對1914年戰局的敘述
heading.en: The Enciclopedia Italiana on the 1914 campaign

body.zh-Hant: 《意大利百科全書》（1933年，署名阿德里亞諾·阿爾貝蒂）稱，他侵入比利時與法國北部，在蒙斯與勒卡托擊敗英軍，並在索姆河一帶擊退馬努里的部隊。該條目又評他一心深入進攻、包抄對手，不惜偏離最高統帥部的指示，只留一個弱軍朝巴黎方向，並說他與左鄰比洛第2軍團之間缺乏協議。
body.en: The Enciclopedia Italiana (1933, signed by Adriano Alberti) says he invaded Belgium and northern France, beat the British at Mons and Le Cateau, and defeated Manoury's forces on the Somme. It adds that, fixed on a deep offensive and on outflanking the enemy, he did not hesitate to depart from the directives of the Supreme Command, leaving a weak corps facing Paris, and that agreements with the neighbouring Second Army under Bülow were lacking.

citations.quote: Invase il Belgio e il nord della Francia
battendo a Mons e a Le Chateau gl'Inglesi
e le forze del Manoury alla Somme
Fisso nell'idea di agire offensivamente a fondo e di aggirare l'avversario
non esitò ad allontanarsi dalle direttive del Comando supremo
lasciando un debole corpo d'armata nella direzione di Parigi
anche per mancati accordi con l'armata laterale (2ª) comandata dal Bülow

heading.en: Wounding, retirement and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1915年1月，他以小規模攻勢在弗雷尼高地附近截彎取直（蘇瓦松之戰）；3月27日於瓦伊視察陣地時身負重傷，第1軍團由法貝克接掌。1916年10月，年屆70歲的他獲准退役。戰後著有《進軍巴黎與馬恩河會戰》（1920年），1934年10月19日卒於柏林。
body.en: In January 1915 a small offensive near the plateau of Vregny straightened the front (the "Battle of Soissons"); on 27 March he was seriously wounded while inspecting positions at Vailly, and General von Fabeck took over the First Army. In October 1916 his request to retire, aged 70, was approved. After the war he wrote "Der Marsch auf Paris und die Marne-Schlacht" (1920); he died in Berlin on 19 October 1934.

heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 1846年3月24日生於柏林。參加過1866年與1870至71年的戰爭，自1877年起任總參謀部上尉。
body.en: Born in Berlin on 24 March 1846. He fought in the wars of 1866 and 1870/71 and from 1877 was a captain on the General Staff of the army.

citations.quote: Mitkämpfer der Kriege von 1866 und 1870/71,
seit 1877 Hauptmann im Generalstab der Armee

heading.en: Peacetime posts

body.zh-Hant: 1894年任近衛第4步兵團團長，1897年任陸軍部中央局局長，1903年任第3軍軍長；1912年晉升大將，任第3軍團監察官。
body.en: In 1894 he became commander of the 4th Foot Guards, in 1897 director of the Central Department in the War Ministry and in 1903 commanding general of the III Army Corps; in 1912, as Generaloberst, he rose to inspector of the III Army Inspection.

citations.quote: wurde B. 1894 Kommandeur des 4. Garde-Regiments zu Fuß
1897 Direktor des Zentral-Departements im Kriegsministerium
1903 Kommandierender General des III. Armeekorps
1912 als Generaloberst zum Inspekteur der III. Armeeinspektion aufgestiegen

heading.en: 1914 offensive in the west and the Marne

body.zh-Hant: 大戰爆發時，他接掌第1、第2兩個軍團的共同指揮權。8月23至24日攻佔那慕爾，29至30日突擊聖康坦，迫使法國第5軍團放棄默茲河與桑布爾河間的陣地，9月4日渡過馬恩河。9月6日法英軍發動反攻，主要針對德軍最右翼的第1軍團；兩軍團之間出現寬30至40公里的缺口，他為防止敵軍突破，於9月9日中止戰鬥。
body.en: At the outbreak of war he took joint supreme command of the First and Second Armies. By taking Namur (23/24 August) and thrusting on St. Quentin (29/30 August) he forced the French Fifth Army out of its positions between the Meuse and the Sambre, and on 4 September he crossed the Marne. When the French and British counter-attacked on 6 September, chiefly against the First Army on the extreme right wing, a gap 30–40 km wide opened between the armies, and to prevent an enemy breakthrough he broke off the battle on 9 September.

die Wegnahme von Namur (23./24.8.)
den Stoß auf St. Quentin (29./30.8.)

gegen die den äußersten deutschen rechten Flügel bildende 1. Armee

heading.en: Field marshal, retirement and assessment

body.zh-Hant: 1914年秋重新起用，1915年1月晉升元帥，同年4月因重病退役。他曾寫有《我的馬恩河會戰報告》（1919年）。NDB作者認為他未能達成和平時期對他的期待，但馬恩河之敗的責任在最高統帥部。他於1921年8月31日卒於柏林。
body.en: He was re-employed in autumn 1914, promoted field marshal in January 1915 and retired in April 1915 because of serious illness. He wrote "Mein Bericht zur Marneschlacht" (1919). The NDB author holds that he did not fulfil the expectations placed in him in peacetime, but that responsibility for the failure on the Marne lay with the Supreme Army Command. He died in Berlin on 31 August 1921.

citations.quote: Herbst 1914 wiederverwendet und Januar 1915 zum Generalfeldmarschall befördert
trat B. April 1915 infolge schwerer Erkrankung in den Ruhestand
Mein Ber. z. Marneschlacht, 1919
die Erwartungen, die man an ihn im Frieden knüpfte, nicht erfüllt hat
Die Schuld trägt die Oberste Heeresleitung

heading.en: The Enciclopedia Italiana on his operations and retirement

body.zh-Hant: 《意大利百科全書》（1930年，署名阿德里亞諾·阿爾貝蒂）稱，列日奇襲成功後，他率第2軍團穿越比利時，強攻奪取那慕爾，是馬恩河會戰的主要人物之一；撤退後又以埃納河之戰擋住法軍前進。1915年1月27日他晉升元帥，4月4日因病離開軍團指揮，1916年6月22日退役。
body.en: The Enciclopedia Italiana (1930, signed by Adriano Alberti) says that after the successful coup de main on Liège he marched with the Second Army through Belgium and took Namur by storm, was one of the principal actors of the battle of the Marne, and afterwards halted the French advance in the battle of the Aisne. He was promoted field marshal on 27 January 1915, left the army command through illness on 4 April, and was retired on 22 June 1916.

con la battaglia dell'Aisne, ad arrestare l'avanzata francese
Il 27 gennaio 1915 fu promosso feldmaresciallo.
Il 4 aprile lasciò, per malattia, il comando dell'armata
fu collocato a riposo il 22 giugno 1916

heading.en: Birth and early military service

body.zh-Hant: 1887年8月17日生於下奧地利的佩爾森貝格。他直到1914年都在騎兵隊任部隊軍官；1914年6月28日叔父弗朗茨·斐迪南遇刺後，成為皇位繼承人。
body.en: Born on 17 August 1887 at Persenbeug (Lower Austria). He served as a troop officer in the cavalry until 1914; after the murder of his uncle Franz Ferdinand on 28 June 1914 he became heir to the throne.

citations.quote: * 17.8.1887 Persenbeug (Niederösterreich)
Als Truppenoffizier diente er bis 1914 bei der Kavallerie
Nach der Ermordung des Onkels am 28.6.1914 wurde er Thronfolger

heading.en: Early war service and corps command

body.zh-Hant: 大戰爆發後，他以上校身分配屬陸軍最高司令部，參加對俄戰事。1915年夏，法蘭茲·約瑟夫皇帝以少將軍銜召他到維也納。1916年5月，在康拉德主張自拉瓦羅內—福爾加里亞高原進攻義大利時，他接任第20（雪絨花）軍指揮官。盧茨克戰敗後被調往東加利西亞，新集團軍司令部的參謀長是普魯士的澤克特。
body.en: After the outbreak of war, as a colonel attached to the Army High Command, he took part in the campaign against Russia. In summer 1915 Emperor Franz Joseph summoned him to Vienna as a major general. In May 1916, when Conrad planned an offensive against Italy from the Lavarone-Folgaria plateaus, he took command of the 20th (Edelweiss) Corps. After the Austrian defeat at Luck he was transferred to East Galicia, where the Prussian General von Seeckt served as chief of staff of his new army-group command.

citations.quote: Als Oberst nahm er nach Kriegsbeginn, dem Armeeoberkommando zugeteilt,
am Feldzug gegen Rußland teil
Im Sommer 1915 berief ihn Kaiser Franz Joseph als Generalmajor nach Wien
Als im Mai 1916 auf Wunsch des Chefs des Generalstabes,
eine Offensive gegen Italien von den Hochflächen von Lavarone-Folgaria

heading.zh-Hant: 1916年：集團軍司令部與羅馬尼亞戰線
heading.en: 1916: army group command and the Romanian front

body.zh-Hant: 據ÖBL，他被調往東加利西亞的霍多羅夫，在抵擋布魯西洛夫攻勢時指揮一個集團軍司令部，普魯士將軍澤克特任其參謀長。8月15日羅馬尼亞宣戰後，特蘭西瓦尼亞的防務也交給該司令部；他其後晉升為騎兵上將、大將與海軍大元帥。11月他被緊急召回維也納。
body.en: According to the ÖBL he was sent to Chodorow in East Galicia, where, in the defence against the Brusilov offensives, he led an army group command with the Prussian General Seeckt as chief of staff. After Romania's declaration of war on 15 August the defence of Transylvania was also entrusted to it; he was then promoted General of Cavalry, Generaloberst and Grand Admiral. In November he was urgently summoned back to Vienna.

nach der rumän. Kriegserklärung (15. 8. 1916)

zum Gen. d. Kav. und zuletzt zum Gen.-Obst. und Großadmiral

heading.zh-Hant: 在位期間：和平嘗試與帝國瓦解
heading.en: Reign: peace feelers and collapse of the empire

body.zh-Hant: 1916年11月21日弗朗茨·約瑟夫去世後，他成為奧地利皇帝與匈牙利國王（12月30日在布達佩斯加冕）。1917年3月24日，皇帝夫婦在拉克森堡接見皇后的兄弟西克斯圖斯與格扎維埃，試探與巴黎的和談；5月31日帝國議會召開時，他強調和平意願。1918年10月16日他嘗試把奧地利一半改為聯邦國家；11月11日簽署放棄行使奧地利國務的文件。
body.en: After the death of Franz Joseph he became Emperor of Austria and King of Hungary on 21 November 1916 (crowned in Budapest on 30 December). On 24 March 1917 the imperial couple received the Empress's brothers Sixtus and Xavier of Bourbon-Parma at Laxenburg to open peace talks with Paris, and when the Reichsrat met on 31 May 1917 he stressed his readiness for peace. On 16 October 1918 he tried to turn the Austrian half into a federal state, and on 11 November 1918 he signed a document renouncing the exercise of government business in Austria.

heading.en: Personal supreme command

body.zh-Hant: 他於1916年12月2日親自接掌最高指揮權，1917年1月初強令總司令部由西里西亞的泰申遷往維也納近郊巴登。據ÖBL，他撤換康拉德，並以阿爾茲任總參謀長。1918年他把最高指揮權交給科韋什元帥，任命日期被倒填為11月2日。
body.en: On 2 December 1916 he personally took over the supreme command, and in early January 1917 he forced the move of headquarters from Teschen in Silesia to Baden near Vienna. According to the ÖBL he removed Conrad's power, with Arz as chief of the General Staff. In 1918 he handed the supreme command to Field Marshal Kövess, the appointment being backdated to 2 November.

heading.en: Exile and restoration attempts

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月24日，他因拒絕正式放棄王位而在英國保護下前往瑞士，並以《費爾德基希宣言》宣告前述文件無效。1921年復活節首次嘗試返回匈牙利，因攝政霍爾蒂拒絕交出政權而失敗；10月20日他搭機與皇后齊塔再度降落匈牙利，其支持者部隊被霍爾蒂的匈牙利民族部隊攔阻。經提哈尼修道院的羈押後，夫婦被英國軍艦送往馬德拉，他於1922年4月1日在當地去世。
body.en: On 24 March 1919, because he refused a formal abdication, he had to travel to Switzerland under British protection; in the Feldkirch declaration he declared the document of 11 November 1918 invalid. At Easter 1921 his first attempt to return to Hungary failed because Regent Horthy refused to hand over power; on 20 October 1921 he landed again in Hungary by aeroplane with Empress Zita, and his royalist troops were halted by Horthy's national Hungarian units. After captivity in Tihany monastery the couple were taken to Madeira on British warships, where he died on 1 April 1922.

heading.en: Origins and service in the Empire and Reichswehr

body.zh-Hant: 1880年10月7日生於勃蘭登堡（哈弗爾河畔）。1899年以少尉入奧斯特羅沃的步兵第155團，曾任排長、營副官與團副官；1908至1911年在柏林戰爭學院受總參訓練。一戰期間在西線與東線服役；1925年任第2師參謀長，1928年任步兵第10團團長，1932年以中將軍階退出國防軍。
body.en: Born on 7 October 1880 in Brandenburg an der Havel. In 1899 he entered Infantry Regiment 155 at Ostrowo as a lieutenant, serving as platoon leader and battalion and regimental adjutant; from 1908 to 1911 he took general-staff training at the Berlin Kriegsakademie. He served on the western and eastern fronts in the First World War; in 1925 he became chief of staff of the 2nd Division, in 1928 commander of the 10th (Saxon) Infantry Regiment, and in 1932 he left the Reichswehr as a lieutenant general.

citations.quote: Geboren am 7. Oktober 1880 in Brandenburg an der Havel
trat 1899 als Leutnant in das Infanterie-Regiment 155 in Ostrowo
wo er als Zugführer sowie Bataillons- und Regimentsadjutant diente
Von 1908 bis 1911 absolvierte er die Generalstabsausbildung

heading.zh-Hant: 加入黨衛軍與特別使用部隊
heading.en: Joining the SS and the SS-Verfügungstruppe

body.zh-Hant: 1933年他加入鋼盔團並任柏林—勃蘭登堡地區領袖。1934年成為少數加入黨衛軍的前國防軍將領之一，奉希姆萊之命創辦布倫瑞克的黨衛軍領導人學校（1935年開辦）；1936年成為黨衛軍特別使用部隊督察。1937年加入納粹黨。
body.en: In 1933 he joined the Stahlhelm and became its Landesführer of Berlin-Brandenburg. In 1934 he was one of very few former Reichswehr generals to join the SS; Himmler commissioned him to set up an SS leadership school at Braunschweig, opened in 1935, and in 1936 he became inspector of the SS-Verfügungstruppe. In 1937 he joined the NSDAP.

heading.en: SS-Verfügungsdivision: Poland, France and the USSR

body.zh-Hant: 1939年波蘭戰役期間，他先以聯絡官身分配屬坎普夫將軍的師；同年秋奉希姆萊之命組建黨衛軍特別使用師（後來的第2黨衛軍師「帝國」），1940年春參加西線對法作戰，一年後參加進攻南斯拉夫。1941年7月至8月該師在斯摩棱斯克之戰取得防禦勝利，10月在波羅金諾附近的突破戰中立下大功；他被彈片擊傷，失去右眼。
body.en: During the 1939 Polish campaign he was first attached as liaison officer to General Kempf's division; in autumn 1939 Himmler told him to raise the SS-Verfügungsdivision (later the 2nd SS Division "Das Reich"), with which he took part in the western campaign against France in spring 1940 and the attack on Yugoslavia a year later. In July/August 1941 the division scored a defensive success in the Battle of Smolensk and in October played a major part in the breakthrough fighting near Borodino, where Hausser was wounded by a shell splinter and lost his right eye.

heading.zh-Hant: II. SS-Panzer-Korps：哈爾科夫、堡壘與諾曼第
heading.en: II SS Panzer Corps: Kharkov, Citadel and Normandy

body.zh-Hant: 1942年春他組建黨衛軍裝甲軍，1943年初在哈爾科夫作戰時無視希特勒的堅守命令，撤出該城以免被圍；數週後該軍決定性地參與收復該城。1943年夏，他率II.黨衛軍裝甲軍參加庫爾斯克弧形地帶的「堡壘」行動。1944年6月，他成為第一位指揮一個軍團的武裝黨衛軍將領；8月第7軍團自法萊斯包圍圈突圍時，他再度負傷。
body.en: In spring 1942 he organised the raising of an SS Panzer Corps, with which he fought at Kharkov in early 1943; he ignored Hitler's order to hold and evacuated the city to prevent encirclement, and a few weeks later the corps played a decisive part in retaking it. In summer 1943 the II SS Panzer Corps led by Hausser took part in Operation Citadel in the Kursk salient. In June 1944 he became the first Waffen-SS general to command an army; he was wounded again in August 1944 when his 7th Army broke out of the Falaise pocket.

heading.en: Army Group G, captivity and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1945年1月他接掌上萊茵的G集團軍群，4月因與希特勒的分歧日增而被免職。5月在奧地利采爾湖畔被美軍俘虜，拘押至1948年；自1951年起為武裝黨衛軍退伍者互助會（HIAG）的領導成員。1972年12月21日卒於路德維希堡。
body.en: In January 1945 he took over Army Group G on the Upper Rhine, until Hitler relieved him of command in April because of increasing differences. In May 1945 he was taken prisoner by the Americans near Zell am See (Austria) and interned until 1948; from 1951 he was a leading member of the Waffen-SS veterans' association HIAG. He died in Ludwigsburg on 21 December 1972.

citations.quote: Im Januar 1945 übernahm er den Oberbefehl über die Heeresgruppe G

heading.en: Origins and First World War service

body.zh-Hant: 1886年12月25日生於東普魯士貢賓嫩，父親是福音派牧師保羅·海因里希。1905年3月8日以軍官候補生入普魯士第95（圖林根第6）步兵團。一戰期間先後任營副官、團副官；1915年8月任營長，1916年8月調入第24預備軍總參謀部，1918年2月任第203步兵師作戰參謀（Ia）。
body.en: Born on 25 December 1886 at Gumbinnen in East Prussia, the son of the Protestant pastor Paul Heinrici. On 8 March 1905 he joined the Prussian (6th Thuringian) Infantry Regiment 95 as an officer cadet. In the First World War he served as battalion and regimental adjutant; in August 1915 he became a battalion commander, in August 1916 joined the general staff of the XXIV Reserve Corps, and in February 1918 became first general-staff officer (Ia) of the 203rd Infantry Division.

citations.quote: * 25. 12. 1886 Gumbinnen / Ostpreußen

heading.en: Reichswehr career and divisional command

body.zh-Hant: 1919年起歷任第1軍總參謀部、軍區司令部等職；1927年10月進國防部。1930年10月任第3步兵團第3營營長，1933年3月任國防部陸軍局總務處處長，1936年1月1日晉少將；1937年10月任駐明斯特的第16步兵師師長，1938年3月1日晉中將。
body.en: From 1919 he held staff posts including the general staff of the I Army Corps; in October 1927 he joined the Reichswehr Ministry. In October 1930 he became commander of the III Battalion of Infantry Regiment 3, in March 1933 head of the General Department of the Army Office in the ministry, was promoted major general on 1 January 1936, took command of the 16th Infantry Division at Münster in October 1937 and became lieutenant general on 1 March 1938.

heading.en: Corps commander and the Eastern Front

body.zh-Hant: 1940年4月8日受命統領第12軍；6月1日晉步兵上將，6月18日任第43軍軍長。該軍1941年6月22日在米耶爾尼克渡過布格河，構成比亞韋斯托克之戰的南翼；8月20日起沿傑斯納河東進，9月17日撤出基輔之戰。10月在「颱風」行動中參與維亞濟馬與布良斯克雙重會戰，擔任布良斯克包圍圈的北翼。
body.en: On 8 April 1940 he was entrusted with leading the XII Army Corps; he became General der Infanterie on 1 June and commanding general of the XXXXIII Army Corps on 18 June. On 22 June 1941 the corps crossed the Bug at Mielnik and formed the southern flank of the Battle of Białystok; from 20 August it advanced east to the Desna and on 17 September it was withdrawn from the Battle of Kiev. In October, in Operation Typhoon, it took part in the double battle of Vyazma and Bryansk, forming the northern flank of the Bryansk pocket.

heading.en: Fourth Army and First Panzer Army

body.zh-Hant: 1942年1月20日他出任第4軍團總司令（東線），1943年1月30日晉大將，同年11月24日獲橡葉騎士鐵十字勳章。1944年6月3日病休，8月16日任第1裝甲軍團總司令（匈牙利、斯洛伐克、波蘭）。依編者之見，他在許多對紅軍的防禦戰中證明自己是能幹的指揮官，使希特勒直到最後都不願放棄他。
body.en: On 20 January 1942 he became commander-in-chief of the Fourth Army (Eastern Front); he was promoted Generaloberst on 30 January 1943 and received the Oak Leaves on 24 November 1943. After sick leave on 3 June 1944 he became commander-in-chief of the First Panzer Army (Hungary, Slovakia, Poland) on 16 August 1944. In the editor's view he proved himself in many defensive battles against the Red Army such a capable commander that Hitler did not want to dispense with him until the end.

heading.en: 1945 army group, captivity and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1945年3月20日他受命統領維斯瓦（Weichsel）集團軍群（奧得河戰線），4月29日被解除指揮權；5月起至1948年5月為英軍戰俘，曾兩度被帶往紐倫堡接受盟軍戰犯審判相關的訊問，本人未受審。他於1971年12月10日卒於卡爾斯魯厄。
body.en: On 20 March 1945 he was entrusted with leading Army Group Vistula (Oder front) and on 29 April he was relieved of command; he was a British prisoner of war from May 1945 to May 1948, was twice brought to Nuremberg to be questioned in connection with the Allied war-crimes trials, but was not himself tried. He died in Karlsruhe on 10 December 1971.
